candidate.definition_en: The ability to move freely or be easily moved.
candidate.explanation_ar: القدرة على الحركة أو التنقل بسهولة.

senses.definition_en: The ability to move physically or be moved freely and easily.
senses.explanation_ar: القدرة على الحركة الجسدية أو التنقل بحرية وسهولة.
examples: He exercises to improve his mobility.

senses.definition_en: The ability to move between different social, economic, or occupational levels.
senses.explanation_ar: القدرة على الانتقال بين المستويات الاجتماعية أو الاقتصادية أو المهنية (الحراك).
examples: Social mobility allows people to improve their status.
The new job offers greater career mobility.
He exercises to improve his mobility.
